widgets_values:
AGORA 03: image to 2,000-triangle prop

BEFORE THE FIRST RUN
Models (ComfyUI/models): diffusion_models/trellis_2_int8_convrot.safetensors, vae/trellis_2_shape_vae_bf16.safetensors, vae/trellis_2_texture_vae_bf16.safetensors, clip_vision/dino_v3_L_naf_fp32.safetensors, background_removal/birefnet.safetensors. Links and licences: agora_output/reverse/yt_bEiW6L7Y7NM/FIRST_CHARACTER_PLAN.md

HOW TO RUN
1. Load Image: full body, exact front view, T-pose, empty hands, plain background, fitted clothing.
2. Run.
3. Check the saved crop: the whole body must be visible.
4. Check the final GLB: tools/comfy_char/check_glb.py <file> --target 2000

WHAT TO CHANGE
Different body: the seed on the "SEED" sampler.
Out of VRAM: Upsample target_resolution 1024.
Fingers or straps break: Decimate target 20000.
Wrong patches in the normal map: raise cage_distance.

NATIVE NODES ONLY: no WTiVo, LODTailor, Bake Forger, UltraTex, or FLUX.2.
